routine.description: Defender retreat target calculation stored in $9406

harness.meaning: after L7F01 stores $9406, pop the routine's two saved bytes, copy $9406 to $C020, and return

mapShape.description: three provinces in a horizontal line

notes: Target province 2 is not owner 2 home.
Province 1 is adjacent and owned by defender 2.
The home-castle check exits before adjacency marking, even though province 1 is defender-owned.
Adjacent provinces exist but neither is owned by defender 2.
Owner 0 skips the player-home check and scans adjacent owner-0 provinces.
The scan runs high-to-low, so province 3 is selected before province 1.

assertionsForPort: Defender retreat legality is the value of $9406, not a generic boolean.
A nonzero player defending their home province cannot retreat, even when adjacent owned provinces exist.
If retreat is legal, L7F01 stores the highest-numbered adjacent defender-owned province in $9406.
Owner 0 can have a legal defender retreat target because the home-castle check is skipped for owner 0.
